title: jig image help, version 1
description: What an image prints as the last line of stdout when run with exactly one argument, --help (exit 0): its actions, their kinds and their flags. jig prints the same object with ok, image and notes added; an image never sends those.

ok.description: Added by jig, like on every object it prints.

image.description: Added by jig: the image pinned to its ID, <name>@sha256:<id>.

notes.description: Added by jig: what resolving the image had to say, such as a cached image used because its registry could not be reached. Left out when there is nothing.

name.description: What the action is called on the command line: not starting with -, without whitespace.

kinds.description: The kinds the action's commits can have.

flags.description: At most one flag has choices with kinds.

flagDescription.description: Plain text, may be several lines.

choice.description: One value of a choice flag: what is passed (name), one line on what it does, and, when picking it decides the commit's kind, that kind.

flag.description: path: one repo-relative path; paths: comma-separated repo-relative paths; globs: comma-separated globs; text: anything else; choice: the name of one of choices (only there, and always).

choices.description: When one choice has a kind, all of them do (checked here; at most one flag of an action has choices with kinds is checked on the action's flags). Names are unique within the flag, and the action's kinds are exactly the kinds the choices use: jig checks these two alone, the schema cannot express them.
